comparison.objective: After cooling, transfer a finished print plate level and install a clean plate on a printer; candidate calibrates and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires timing, level bimanual plate transport, loose-part retention, and locating-pin alignment rather than small-tool countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Checks cooling order, print retention, used-plate placement, clean-plate fit, release, and stillness; candidate checks angle, nuts, three cycles, drift, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Printer plate exchange tests transport and installation, not mechanical calibration or locknut-secured retention.
